typeProperties.script:
parameters{
	DatabaseId as string (),
	DSTTempPhysicalITem_outputfilename as string ()
}

source(output(
		DatabaseName as string,
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		SchemaName as string,
		IS_NULLABLE as boolean,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false) ~> SRCLoadETLMetadata
SRCLoadETLMetadata derive(DatabaseId = $DatabaseId) ~> DerivedColumn
DerivedColumn sink(input(
		TableName as string,
		ColumnName as string,
		TableColumnValueFlag as string,
		IsNullable as boolean,
		DatabaseName as string,
		DatabaseId as integer,
		SchemaName as string
	),
	allowSchemaDrift: true,
	validateSchema: false,
	saveOrder: 10000,
	mapColumn(
		TableName,
		ColumnName,
		TableColumnValueFlag,
		IsNullable = IS_NULLABLE,
		DatabaseName,
		DatabaseId,
		SchemaName),
	partitionFileNames:[($DSTTempPhysicalITem_outputfilename)],
	partitionBy('hash', 1)) ~> DSTTempPhysicalITem
